messages.subject: Follow-up | Strategic Value Creation Brief for Orsted
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Errboe,

Following my earlier introduction, I prepared a concise strategic value brief focused on Orsted's current priorities and where my experience in government relations, ESG, stakeholder delivery and executive coordination may be relevant.

The paper looks at project execution, permitting and institutional alignment, energy-security positioning, local stakeholder confidence and disciplined delivery across complex markets. My executive CV is included in the final three pages.

I would welcome a confidential discussion regarding international leadership needs across external affairs, government relations, stakeholder strategy, sustainability or country-facing execution.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
ragunauthramsaroop.com
linkedin.com/in/ragunauth-ramsaroop

strategic_brief.title: Strategic Value Creation Brief for Orsted
strategic_brief.executive_summary: Orsted enters the next phase of offshore wind with stronger operational performance, a reinforced capital structure and renewed emphasis on disciplined project delivery. At the same time, European energy security, electrification, permitting, supply-chain resilience and public acceptance remain central to the pace of renewable deployment. My background in government relations, ESG, regulated project coordination and stakeholder governance would support Orsted by strengthening the bridge between executive strategy, public institutions, local stakeholders and operational delivery across markets where political alignment and social confidence directly influence schedule, cost and long-term value.
strategic_brief.company_context: During 2026 Orsted reported stronger operating performance and continued progress across an 8.1 GW offshore wind construction portfolio. Management has also stressed the importance of European electrification, energy security, stronger supply chains and faster deployment. Rasmus Errboe's September 2026 appointment as Chair of WindEurope places additional visibility on the policy and industry agenda around permitting, grids, competitiveness and investment. These priorities create a strong need for integrated government and stakeholder execution. Large energy projects depend on national policy, local approvals, workforce and supplier ecosystems, community acceptance, environmental commitments and credible delivery evidence. A structured external-affairs operating model can help connect these dependencies to project decisions and executive oversight.

opportunities.title: Permitting and government alignment
opportunities.rationale: Offshore wind schedules depend on coordinated action across national governments, regulators, grid authorities and local institutions. A disciplined stakeholder map and escalation model can reduce fragmentation and keep policy dependencies visible to project leadership.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would connect regulatory milestones, government engagement and project ownership in one executive governance structure, using issue registers, named owners and evidence-based escalation to support timely decisions.

opportunities.title: Local stakeholder confidence
opportunities.rationale: Major renewable projects affect communities, ports, suppliers, workers and local authorities. Early alignment on local value, commitments and grievance pathways can strengthen confidence and reduce avoidable delays during construction and operations.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would structure local-value and community governance around clear commitments, measurable outcomes and cross-functional ownership, informed by direct experience managing community and institutional interfaces around large resource projects.

opportunities.title: Energy-security narrative and policy execution
opportunities.rationale: Orsted is positioning offshore wind as part of Europe's competitiveness and energy-security response. Turning that narrative into policy traction requires consistent evidence, targeted institutional engagement and alignment between commercial priorities and public-policy messages.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would help link project evidence, economic contribution, supply-chain outcomes and sustainability performance into a focused government-affairs agenda suited to ministers, regulators, industry bodies and strategic partners.

opportunities.title: Cross-market stakeholder playbook
opportunities.rationale: Orsted operates across jurisdictions with different political, regulatory and community dynamics. A repeatable diagnostic model can improve consistency while preserving market-specific execution and local accountability.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would build a market-entry and project-support playbook covering institutional mapping, permitting risk, local participation, community expectations, executive reporting and issue escalation for priority jurisdictions.

days_0_30: Map priority projects, institutions, permitting dependencies and stakeholder commitments.
Identify external risks with direct schedule or value impact.
Review current escalation and executive reporting routes.
days_31_60: Align project, government-affairs, sustainability and commercial owners.
Create a consolidated stakeholder and commitment register.
Define leading indicators for permitting and stakeholder risk.
days_61_90: Run targeted engagement on highest-priority institutional dependencies.
Strengthen evidence for local-value and sustainability messages.
days_91_180: Scale the model across selected markets and projects.
Measure issue closure, commitment performance and engagement outcomes.
Codify lessons into a cross-market playbook.

potential_impact: Better visibility of permitting and institutional dependencies at executive level.
Stronger local stakeholder confidence around large renewable projects.
Closer alignment between policy engagement, project delivery and investment priorities.
More consistent external-affairs execution across markets.
background_relevance: Director-level experience across government relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs and executive advisory.
Direct coordination with ministries, regulators, communities and contractors in a complex resource environment.
Experience translating external commitments into accountable workstreams across operations, legal, finance, procurement and environment.
Practical exposure to large-scale renewable-energy positioning and carbon-accounting governance within mining operations.
